caption: One case from the record UNITARES keeps of its own development.

entries.text: A new agent's automatic pause can be lifted whenever the pause is labelled a risk stop.
Rejected. The label names only the first stop the code found, so it cannot show that no other stop fired at the same moment.
The fix was rebuilt to lift a pause only when the full record proves risk was the only stop. A second review agreed, and it merged the same day.
